description: Creates a new custom OAuth scope for a CIMD Domain. You must specify the Id of the CIMD domain you are creating the scope for. You can optionally specify an Id for the OAuth scope on the URL, if not provided one will be generated.

domainId.description: The Id of the CIMD domain to create the OAuth scope on.

requestBody.description: The CIMD domain OAuth scope API request object.

scope.description: A custom OAuth scope for a CIMD domain.
